Subject: Invoice sender + monthly delivery for multi-entity accounts

Hi Priya,

Quick question as we're setting up AP for Redwood: we have three legal entities that will be billed (US, UK, DE). Who will appear as the invoice sender on the PDF (Bill From)? We need consistency for our ERP mapping. Also, are you able to send consolidated monthly invoices to a portal, or should we expect email PDFs? Our AP team prefers portal drops for the UK entity due to VAT reconciliation.

Also attached is our VAT mapping template — can you confirm the fields you'll populate?

Thanks,
Sara Hill\Senior AP Manager\Acme Corp
Attachment: acme-vat-mapping-request.pdf (pdf)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 13:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice sender + monthly delivery for multi-entity accounts

Hi Sara — thanks for the template and the heads up.

Short answers up front:
- Invoice "Bill From" will be the billing legal entity matching the model of usage (we support per-entity invoices). For simplicity for Acme, we can either:
  1) issue invoices per legal entity (US/UK/DE) with the corresponding VAT/Tax details populated, or
  2) issue a consolidated monthly invoice with line-level entity tags and include a per-entity breakdown CSV in the portal.

- Portal drops: we support both. Our recommended default for multinational customers is to deliver the official PDF to your Finance portal (SFTP/API/Webhook) and also send an email copy to AP inboxes you specify. Portal delivery is what helps with VAT evidence attachments and audit trails.

Action items for us to confirm:
1) Which delivery channel do you prefer per entity (portal vs email)?
2) Who should we CC on email copies (if any)?
3) Confirm whether you want separate invoices per entity or consolidated with entity tags.

I'm looping in Marissa from Billing who'll prepare a sample invoice and Ben on engineering to outline the portal delivery mechanics (SFTP vs API).

Best,
Priya Natarajan\Account Operations Lead\Redwood Inference

One additional ask: our security team requires that each monthly drop include a unique invoice sender token in the file name to match our rotation policy (we rotate the receiving SFTP credentials quarterly). Regards,

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Invoice sender + monthly delivery for multi-entity accounts

Sara — quick tech reply and confirmation of next steps.

- Portal delivery: we support SFTP drops with filename templating. We can append a short sender token (e.g., ACME-SEND-<YYYYMM>) as requested and produce a separate mapping CSV in the same drop.
- VAT totals: yes — for consolidated invoices we'll add per-entity VAT subtotal rows and a reconciliation appendix in the CSV. The PDF itself will show entity subtotals across the billing period.
- CC/email copies: we'll configure email copies to accounts-payable@acme-corp.com and ap-uk@acme-corp.com.

Next steps:
1) Marissa to confirm date/time for first SFTP drop (suggest: 2028-08-02 06:00 UTC).
2) Priya to request AP whitelist of sftp.redwood.ai (IPs will be provided) and confirm quarterly credential rotation schedule.
3) Sara to confirm whether you want per-entity invoices starting Aug or consolidated with entity tags.

I'll prepare a short runbook and example filenames.

Thanks,
Ben Carter\Product Ops Engineer\Redwood Inference
